name: Side-Lying Dumbbell External Rotation
cues: Lie on your side with a small rolled towel under your top elbow
Bend that elbow to 90 degrees, dumbbell resting in front of your stomach
Rotate your forearm up toward the ceiling, elbow pinned to your side
Stop before your torso starts to roll back

qa.note: Family review 2026-10-01 rated minor. review: Was effectively needs_work: straight legs stuck out about 0.5 m past the bench end, held level in the air. Rebuilt as a curled side-lying pose (hips 38, knees 120, top leg turned out 21 so knees and feet stack): shins rest on the seat, feet end just past it, thighs press within the default 15 mm (36 mm override removed). The towel under the top elbow is now shown. Forearm rotates from the stomach towards the ceiling with the elbow pinned. Minor because the pose was rebuilt this pass, the towel is new and the knees overhang the front edge by about 13 cm: owner should look. | skeptic: The rotation is right: shoulder_r.rot goes from -58 to +52 with the humerus pinned (plane 20, elev 12) on the towel, and the head rests on the bottom arm. The pose around it is new and has things the owner should judge. (1) In the top-view stick sheet the curled knees and feet overhang the bench's front edge and end by about 10-15 cm. The front sheet (figure-215-front.png) reads as a tangle of legs hanging off the left side of the narrow pad, though the hero at az -60 hides most of it. (2) The pelvis is held at list -77 (13 deg rolled back towards supine) for the whole loop, next to a cue that says 'stop before your torso starts to roll back'. It does not roll during the rep, but in the hero the chest and abs face the camera. (3) At the bottom (hero t=0.5-0.625) the dumbbell sits nearer the front of the hip and shorts than 'in front of your stomach'. | skeptic: Minor is right. The rebuilt curled pose puts the shins across the narrow pad, with both feet hanging in the air past the near pad edge (foot/figure-215-foot_R.png, all frames). From the front view the pose reads as a tangle: knees overhang one side and feet the other (front/figure-215-front.png). The towel has the same black-pipe look as on 211 (215-yawm60 close-up t=0.5).
